author: fazer153
body:
Just wanted to say bye cus after all I have been here for a pretty long time. I started a couple months before Avicus got here doing mainly nebula (now known as DTM) and shit on McZone. When Avicus came I started playing mainly elimination (hunger games with chests) and I believe I was the first to ever prestige there. If not then I was def in the top 3 first ones.

Throughout the years I have been here I am glad to have been able to be a part of the community. On top of that I am glad to have experienced many hypes in the server such as waiting for Avicore (which took 17 years to come out). That was Avicus' prime.
I still remember when this server had a steady 1000 players which ended up peaking to 1200 one time. It's pretty crazy considering that Avicus has been struggling to reach 100 players or even 50 for the last couple of years.

I don't play MC that much anymore as I have lost interest and the fact that I am no longer a PvP god.
If you wanna ask anything ask away but you probably shouldn't ask thought on you guys cus I don't really know any of you motherfuckers lol because I never went on teamspeak or anything.

It has been a real good ride but as you guys now all good things come to and end. 

Too bad I never made it to 10 false bans gg rip.
